_comment: Armour set auras (owner's values). Wearing the set's pieces (item-sets.json from the Grimoire import says which and how many) grants the aura of the set's reward item, matched by the start of its name. health/energy are added to the maximums; divine is the damage of a Divine Strike that procs on auto-attack hits with divineStrikeChance. Sets not listed here use the reward item's own bonuses from the game data.
